result_summary.title: Critical: Webhooks failing with HTTP 500 in Analytics Dashboard
result_summary.description: Our webhooks configured for the Analytics Dashboard in the ME production region have stopped firing entirely. When we attempt to trigger them manually or via events, we receive HTTP 500 errors. This is a critical issue affecting over 15,000 users as downstream processes are blocked.

final_diagnosis.recommended_next_action: Verify the server-side error in Analytics Dashboard and investigate further to determine the root cause.
final_diagnosis.evidence_summary: The issue is likely related to a server-side error in the Analytics Dashboard, specifically with the Webhook Dispatch Service. The evidence suggests that there are API schema validation failures and HTTP 409 Conflict spikes, which could be causing the webhooks to fail. Further investigation is needed to determine the root cause and recommend a solution.
